speaker: Ferryman Odo
lines: [TRIAL RUN: a temporary quest that shows off every minigame. Rewrite or delete it freely.]
"The old mill's cellar broke through into something older last spring," the ferryman says, poling you across the flooded millpond. "A vault. Drowned halls, rune doors, and a stone thing that walks."
He spits over the side. "Nobody who went down came back up rich. You might be the first."

choices.text: Visit the practice hall first (try any single trial).
